start_here.caption: Visit the editorial bridge, then open each original public source.

chapters.title: What We Can—and Cannot—Deconstruct
chapters.activity: Read the author-context essay and identify the product constraints that shaped its release.
chapters.expected: A short note distinguishing author history from claims about MemeArcade, the App.

chapters.title: The Native Shell: SwiftUI and Combine
chapters.activity: Trace a reactive state change from publisher to SwiftUI view.

chapters.title: Modularity as Architecture
chapters.activity: Map a package boundary and the tandem demo-app contract.

chapters.title: Persistence as Device Infrastructure
chapters.activity: Trace observable state through encrypted persistence.

chapters.title: Async/Await
chapters.activity: Trace one request, cancellation, and failure state.

chapters.title: Observing the Network Boundary
chapters.activity: Separate observable client behavior from backend inference.

chapters.title: Two Runtimes, One Application
chapters.activity: Build a WebView capability table and define a navigation trust policy.
chapters.expected: A bounded trust model with explicit native ownership.

chapters.title: GamePlayer I
chapters.activity: Trace pager ownership, cell reuse, and WebView isolation.
chapters.expected: A lifecycle sketch with explicit ownership.

chapters.title: GamePlayer II
chapters.activity: Measure activation and memory trade-offs before prewarming.

chapters.title: Seeing Across Native and Web
chapters.activity: Build a privacy-safe lifecycle trace and failure taxonomy.
chapters.expected: A bounded event vocabulary with recovery categories.

chapters.title: Pushscheduler
chapters.activity: Identify permission, persistence, schedule, and routing boundaries.

chapters.title: Deconstructing One Complete Session
chapters.activity: Trace a complete native-to-web-to-native session and assign one owner to every handoff.
chapters.expected: A responsibility trace with validation and cancellation rules.

chapters.title: From MemeArcade to Reusable Architecture
chapters.activity: Propose an extraction with explicit inputs, outputs, lifecycle, forbidden dependencies, fixtures, and product policy that stays outside.
chapters.expected: A reusable contract with an explicit private and product-specific boundary.
